title: Achillea millefolium essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Achillea millefolium essential oil is derived from the dried flowers of the yarrow plant, known for its aromatic and therapeutic properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of colds and respiratory issues. The oil is often applied topically for its antiseptic and wound-healing qualities, and it can also be used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and ease stress. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its ability to support the circulatory system and reduce fever. Its versatile applications make it a valuable component in both internal and external herbal preparations.
